title: Agent color palette without gray/green, column color inheritance, reactive icons, and agent tool matrix
author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Implemented agent color palette strictly excluding gray (#64748b) and green (#10b981) reserved for backlog and ready. Implemented automatic column color inheritance from assigned agent persona. Enforced reactive SVG agent icon display in Cortex Explorer. Added gray/green styling for backlog/ready columns in Cortex Explorer. Restructured ToolPolicyModal to display agent personas instead of columns.
